assertions: Original source spawn, floor and HP/weapon configuration
Real dagger contact removes original NPC HP
Actual hand/POS dart release precedes flight damage
Actual WP9 to WP53/80/32 movement through source collision
Source NPC AI reaches and damages the player

boundaries: No complete live-AI combat victory or manual mission completion has been demonstrated.
The 3-NPC win test freezes NPC physical retaliation and places the player near original NPC spawns; it does not prove full combat victory from the source player spawn.
The live-AI failure test uses ordinary movement from the original player spawn without directly assigning HP/dead.
Rule10 completion remains an explicit host inference, not a recovered EXE GameRule.
Dart flight constants and actor/world collision approximations are browser adapters; advanced projectiles and complete EF behavior remain pending.
Previous E-mission-host 38-test results and E-web-deployment describe an earlier snapshot; this validation does not attest a new hosted deployment.
The original d_base scene translation is suppressed only for browser in-place collision-aligned playback; bone-local pose and authored rootMotion playback remain intact.
Meatbun support is limited to sn01 story mode; pickup input/range, full-HP retention and no timed respawn are browser adapters, not recovered EXE rules.

The current local version has not been uploaded or deployed: automatic approval review rejected the external upload and explicit user authorization is still outstanding. The earlier private deployment is historical only.
